title: Executing-runbook (cross-regime step iterator over a pre-settled runbook)
description: Regime: cross-regime composing morphism. Controller is aperiodic-articulation-category at the outer level (the executor's effective closure ordinal κ is bounded above by max(step regimes) — a runbook whose steps include inferring is aperiodic-articulating overall). The runbook record itself is finite-settlement-algebra (pre-settled finite step list), but invoking its steps walks the regime chain — any single step may be in any regime. The executor iterates over runbook.steps in order, dispatches each step to a handler keyed by step.expectedWitness, accumulates witness rows tagged with the step's regime, and threads context (output of step n becomes input of step n+1 by handler convention). When a step's regime is finite-settlement-algebra the handler completes in finite time; when aperiodic-articulating (an inferring step) the handler awaits the remote endpoint. The executor's witness emission makes every step's regime auditable in the event log.
